items.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
items.summary: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

items.title: XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why
items.summary: XRP remains below its 2017-cycle high while bitcoin, ether and other major tokens have surged, enriching their holders.

items.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
items.summary: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

items.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.

items.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
items.summary: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.
